palette.mood: Collegiate oxblood, parchment, marigold, brass, and mint make a public-institution promise feel warm and consequential. Mint appears only when AI is actively assisting.
palette.divergence: This avoids September 1's aubergine, fuchsia, and cosmic rose signal world and August 30's cyan, persimmon, spruce, and violet technical field. Parchment is dominant, marigold separates campus judgment, and oxblood anchors human accountability.

light.time: Early-morning library light begins cool at the proposal table, warms through the human review desk, and reaches a sunrise backlight on the earned seal.
light.direction: A high-left amber key shapes paper and brass; a low-right mint rim belongs to active AI assistance; oxblood bounce and the #54252E shadow token keep every dark plane warm rather than near-black.
light.depth: Four parallax planes, cast paper shadows, beveled press parts, moving specular bands, contact shadows, and a shallow-focus macro at the stamp make the tactile collage dimensional.

shape_language.grammar: Soft paper arcs and hand-cut campus rooms oppose rigid machine rails, gates, and rectangular governance files.
shape_language.why: The film asks where flexible academic judgment must resist an efficient system that wants to flatten every decision.

casting.net_new: DiplomaPress and its small StampBot supporting pose fill the credential and rubber-stamp gaps; documentFlip is the motion-system advance.
casting.continuity: Character, document, gate, type, clock, lighting, materials, and motion systems carry the film. SignalRibbon does not return as hero.

motion_language.grammar: Paper travels horizontally, the press strikes vertically, and governance assembles radially around the same sheet.
hero_moves: The stamp anticipates, plunges, and brakes one millimeter above the blank seal
The diploma flips on its long edge into a consequential-decision file
The frozen clock tries to tick and is caught by the DRAFT clip
A human pull lands the seal with overshoot, screen shake, brass glint, and paper follow-through
motion_language.blur: Directional motion blur is reserved for the rejected auto-stamp, the diploma-to-file flip, and the final human press.

composition.staging: Alternate macro press inserts, overhead paper choreography, three-room campus split, modular decision files, and an extreme-wide clock chamber. The diploma remains centered across motivated match cuts.
composition.safe_area: All load-bearing faces, the diploma, DRAFT, IF ADOPTED, EARNED, and decision labels stay inside the centered 760px square-safe column above the open-caption band.
composition.signature_shot: The diploma flips in midair into a four-tab admissions, aid, advising, and HR record while its empty gold seal becomes a literal human-oversight lock.

craft_advance.api: documentFlip({progress, front, back, tabs, hinge:'long-edge', perspective, shadowDepth})
craft_advance.how: The sheet anticipates to minus eight degrees, accelerates through a foreshortened edge-on phase, overshoots to one hundred two degrees, settles at ninety, and drives a separate squash-and-stretch contact shadow. The API can power future credential, permitting, records, and review transformations.
craft_advance.asset_note: DiplomaPress is the episode's new hero asset; documentFlip is the single craft-system advance measured independently of the hero addition.
